evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: To fill this gap, we introduce AgentHop, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,011 multiple-choice questions paired with a controlled seven-tool sandbox under fixed token, turn, and tool-call constraints.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Agentic tasks require a large language model to interact with the world, navigating information and gathering evidence across multiple steps with restricted resources.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: AgentHop reveals model vulnerabilities by dissecting a single accuracy score along four axes of agent operation: retrieval, synthesis, tool-call, and resource management.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across 19 models, we find that behavior clusters by model family, with tool-call signatures revealing distinct family fingerprints: GPT models commit early, Anthropic and GLM checkpoints verify before committing, DeepSeek and Kimi over-search, and Gemini-3 Pro stays balanced.
